headline: President Obama created a White House council to coordinate federal help for struggling cities and local communities.
what_it_does: This order set up a White House Council on Strong Cities, Strong Communities. Based on the title, the council's job is to coordinate how federal agencies work with and support cities and communities. No summary was provided, so details about its members, powers, and specific programs are not covered here.

who_it_affects.how: They may receive more coordinated support from federal agencies through the new council.
They are likely expected to take part in the council and coordinate their work with local communities.
